Description.description: One row per period x program x customer_segment x measure_category x DAC status. Absorbed dims: customer_segment_code and measure_category_code. When measure_category_code is NULL the row feeds program-level summary tables A1-A4; when populated it feeds installation-count tables A5-A8. Produces all 10 ConEd report tables A1-A10.
Absorbed enum: customer segment (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, INDUSTRIAL, ALL).
Energy savings in MMBtu attributable to this spending record.
Unique identifier for entity instances
Section A program-level high-impact DAC share (0-100). Null on Non-DAC rows; populated on DAC rows only.
Total incentive dollars paid out for this combination of period, program, segment, and DAC status.
Number of installations recorded. Null when measure_category_code is null.
Absorbed enum: measure category for installation counting. Null for program-level rows.
Number of participants for this period-program-segment-DAC combination.
Participant segment from legacy Table A3: Residential, Multifamily, Multisector, or Commercial.
Reference to the reporting period associated with this record. Links this fact record to the corresponding period in the DIM PERIOD table.

Reference to the DAC status associated with this record. Links this fact record to the corresponding DAC status in the DIM DAC STATUS table.
Reference to the program associated with this record. Links this fact record to the corresponding program in the DIM PROGRAM table.
